original_game_physics_planar_test.test: Original CarPhysics / GarageConfig on planar fixture
original_game_physics_planar_test.limitations: Not Roblox, real 3D collision/suspension, networking, streaming or a live executor test

exploratory_map_tests.scope: 30 seconds per minimap line, S13, target 30 degrees, requested 80 km/h, original tyre code on planar rig
exploratory_map_tests.interpretation: Road tracking stayed near the centerline in these short runs; angle tracking was less accurate on Circuit sharp / low-speed transitions. These are not full-map or live Roblox validations.

limitations: Planar fixtures omit 3D collision and suspension dynamics, other cars, streaming and network corrections.
The target angle eases at low speed; collisions, sharp curves and side changes can cause larger transient errors.
The script does not grant admin permissions or alter server-owned upgrades, currency or other players.
